hook: Deewar par teen doston ke saath chautha kaun chal raha tha?
hook_text: Ginte hi teen ke chaar nikle
feedback: Great twist ending and very effective use of cold-open flash-forward. To improve: 1) The emotional setup in the first 8-10 seconds is slightly rushed—give Aman a small warm moment with his friends before revealing the factory danger so his death hits harder. 2) Ensure the phone message text in the audio uses natural spoken Hinglish rather than reading like a formal alert. 3) The script duration (67s) is slightly longer than the 40-52s target limit; tighten 1-2 middle cuts to keep the pace snappy for Instagram.
lines: Deewar par teen doston ke saath chautha kaun chal raha tha?
Par ye khaufnak raat bees minute pehle shuru hui...
Jalpaiguri ki is band factory mein raat teen baje sir ginna mana tha.
Aman apne doston ki hifazat ke liye hamesha aage rehta tha.
Teenon dost shart lagakar is purani factory ke andar ghuse.
Achanak Kabir ki torch deewar par padi.
Deewar par teen nahi, char saaye lahra rahe the!
Ghabrakar teenon turant bahar ki oor bhage.
Gate par pahunchte hi Kabir ka phone baja...
Aman ne jeb se apna phone nikala.
Message tha... 'Bhai, Aman ki bike ka accident ho gaya!'
Aman ne mudkar dekha... uski laash sadak par padi thi.
Wo khud wo aatma tha, jo doston ke saath chal rahi thi.
Raat ko doston sang niklo, toh kabhi apni parchhain mat ginna.
